div.head: Grið 13.2
div.ab: ⁊ se þe man ofslehð binnan cyricderum, sylle þære cyrican CXX scill' be Norðengla lage.
And se þe man ofslehð binnan cyricderum, sylle þære cyrican CXX scillinga be Norðengla lage.
Und wer einen Menschen erschlägt innerhalb der Kirchenportale [Vorhalle], gebe der Kirche 120 Schill. nach Nordengländer Recht.
And whoever kills a person within the church doors [porch] shall give the church 120 shillings according to the law of the northern English.
And anyone who slays a man within the church doors is to give to that church one hundred and twenty shillings according to northern English law.
div.note: Liebermann suggests ‘e’ for ‘y’ in ‘cyricderum’ may be Kentish.

note.seg: Stilistisch endet Nordenglisches hier. Allein der Zusammenhang von 14 mit 13, 2, der friðstol 16 sowie die Trennung des C. 15 von 9 und des C. 16 von 3—5 trotz Behandlung desselben Falles beweist, dass Verf. hier das gegen o. 3ff. 9 verschiedene Rechtsgebiet weiter behandeln will

Stylistically the Northern English material ends here. But the connection of 14 with 13, 2, the friðstol in 16, and the separation of cap. 15 from 9 and of cap. 16 from 3—5 although they treat the same case, prove that the author intends here to go on dealing with the legal area that differs from that of above 3ff. 9
